messages:
Priya Shah: Team — we need a concise one-pager + launch plan for enterprise secure deployments (focus: security controls, SLA tiers, deploy modes). Goal: field-ready asset + benchmark narrative + webinar tease for Q2.
Liam Chen: Understood. Target audience: platform leads, CISOs, and infra PMs. Length: 1 page + 1 slide. CTA: request a dedicated demo or download.
Aisha Patel: Do we have fresh benchmark numbers to call out? latency and cost per 1k tokens across hosted vs dedicated vs private?
Eli Rogers: I can pull the latest perf matrix. Quick headline: "Predictable inference at <X>ms p95 with reserved capacity" — but will update with real numbers by EOD.
Tom Rivera: Recommend including a short guidance box: when to choose Hosted / Dedicated / Private (3 bullets each). Keep messaging prescriptive.
Priya Shah: Love that. Also: routing guidance for inbound leads — we should auto-route Private/VPC inquiries to AE queue+SE review. Can we add HubSpot form fields to capture deployment constraints? @OpsBot can you create a form stub?
OpsBot: Created draft HubSpot form: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/secure-deploy-intent (stub). Fields: Org size, Compliance needs, Preferred deploy mode, SLA need, Contact. Assigned to pipeline: AE - Priority.
Aisha Patel: Nice. For the benchmark narrative we should show a simple cost/latency tradeoff graphic and 2 quick thumbnails: "3x cost savings with KV-caching on steady-state traffic" and "<30% p95 latency improvement with Dedicated autoscale" — need validation from Eng-runtime.
Eli Rogers: Confirming engineering review: I'll validate the KV-caching numbers and dedicated autoscale numbers by tomorrow. If anything changes we'll call out ranges not absolutes.
Liam Chen: For the webinar — propose 45 min: 20 min benchmark walkthrough, 15 min demo (hosted->dedicated migration flow), 10 min customer panel / Q&A. Panel ask: SE + Eng-runtime + Field CS. Target date: 2 weeks after one-pager publish.
Priya Shah: Timeline: Draft one-pager + slide by Thu COB, Eng review Thu-Fri, legal signoff early next week, publish + email + social + webinar sign-up week after. Assign owners: Aisha (copy + design), Eli (benchmarks + eng signoff), Tom (field positioning + CTAs), Liam (webinar logistics).
Aisha Patel: I'll drop a Draft Google Doc link by lunchtime: https://docs.google.com/d/secure-deploy-onepager-draft
Tom Rivera: I'll prepare routing playbook bullet list for SDRs (how to triage SLA vs security asks) and a short canned reply.
Priya Shah: Great. Final check items: 1) explicit SLA table (SLOs + escalation), 2) data residency / KMS note for Private, 3) clear CTA and inbound routing URL, 4) benchmark caveats. Anything else?
Liam Chen: Add a short "what success looks like" metrics box (MQL -> AE meeting rate, demo conversion, webinar signups).
Priya Shah: Perfect. We'll reconvene Friday standup for a quick review. :thumbsup:
